title: WalletStateMessage
description: The receiving session's actor's credit balance, as the server holds it at `tick` (p1-03, ADR-0016). Sent once right after SESSION_READY (after INVENTORY_STATE) and again in every tick in which that actor's balance changed - for SELL_MINERAL, in the same tick, last of its responses: COMMAND_RESULT, SALE_RECEIPT, INVENTORY_STATE, WALLET_STATE (spec p1-03 section 5.1a). A full state, not a delta. THE CLIENT NEVER COMPUTES A BALANCE (spec p1-03 I-77): what it shows is always the last WALLET_STATE - never 'old balance + the price I saw'. The wallet belongs to the actor, not the ship, like the inventory (ADR-0013 section 1). An actor that has never sold anything has balance_cr 0 - there is no 'no wallet' state on the wire.

actor_id.description: Owner. Always the receiving session's actor.

balance_cr.description: Balance in whole credits (1 credit is the minor unit). Never negative.
